svg.text: ESP32-C6 SuperMini · Murata US18650VTC6 · AM2315C · Chirp! — component placement and wiring

g.text: ▬ bottom blue rail = GND (jumper to top blue → right edge)
3V3 OUT runs as a SEPARATE wire from SuperMini to MOSFET S pin —
no rail assigned to always-on 3V3 to avoid confusion with gated.
1. SuperMini on breadboard, USB-C clear on the side.
2. AO3401 breakout + resistors R_PU/R_G/R1/R2/R3/R4 on board.
3. Yellow DuPont wires — from SuperMini pins to the correct columns.
4. Sensor cables (AM2315C, Chirp) to the right edge of the bb.
5. Battery holder + protection separately — soldering / heat-shrink.
6. Connect protection P+/P− to top rails — last of all.
⚠ Before powering: check +BAT vs GND for short circuit!
